== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|He could hear his opponents nearing as he stood before [[Chieftain Utahein|Utahein]], whose nostrils flared at the tinge of blood that wafted through the air. He had one chance to do this right.}}

=== Sold by ===
* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the [[Ardent Glorious Legguards (skin)|Ardent Glorious Legguards skin]] or [[Glorious Hero's Legguards]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[PvP Rank]] of 100 is required.
